name: saldin
description: Understand and manage Saldin financial records from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Saldin account to understand balances, spending, card bills, installments, budgets, goals and cash-flow projections. With the permissions you choose, Saldin can also record or update supported financial records. Saldin never initiates bank transfers or payments, and you can revoke access at any time.
defaultPrompt: How much can I still spend this month?
Which installments are in my next card bills?
Show my cash-flow projection through month end.

prompts: How much can I still spend this month?
Show my next card bills and installments.
Record a R$ 84.90 grocery expense after I choose the account.
Alert me when restaurant spending reaches R$ 1,000 this month.
review.commerce_description: Saldin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Saldin Pro subscriptions are purchased and managed separately in the iPhone app through the App Store.

positive.description: Render the complete personal financial overview with the MCP App card.
positive.prompt: Show my current financial overview and how much I am projected to have at month end.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only the granted persona, uses the Saldin financial UI, distinguishes current and projected balances, and includes no data from another persona.

positive.prompt: Show my October 2026 spending report using the month when each card bill is due.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the report with month 2026-10 and basis due_month, renders income and expenses in the Saldin UI, and states the due-month basis.

positive.description: Show the selected card's bills and installments.
positive.prompt: Show the next bills and outstanding amounts for my Roxinho card.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Roxinho from the granted directory, renders only that card's bills, and preserves due dates and outstanding amounts returned by Saldin.

positive.description: Record one supported expense with write permission.
positive.prompt: Record a confirmed R$ 84.90 grocery expense today in my Nubank account, categorized as Mercado.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the granted account and category IDs, records exactly 84.90 BRL once with an idempotency key, and reports possible duplicates instead of creating another copy on retry.

positive.prompt: Alert me when restaurant spending reaches R$ 1,000 this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one category-spending monitor in the granted persona with amount 1000.00 BRL and explains that Saldin evaluates and sends the alert.

negative.description: Saldin does not move real money.
negative.prompt: Transfer R$ 500 from my Nubank account to another person's bank account now.

negative.description: External agents cannot create structural financial accounts.
negative.prompt: Create a new checking account called Banco Novo in Saldin.

negative.description: Deletion is unavailable without a separate delete grant.
negative.prompt: Delete every transaction from last month.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies that card-bill payments and installment anticipations are recorded in Saldin rather than executed, while preserving the scoped financial tools and interactive views.

pt-BR.subtitle: Suas finanças em contexto
pt-BR.description: Conecte sua conta Saldin para entender saldos, gastos, faturas, parcelas, orçamentos, metas e projeções. Com as permissões que você escolher, o Saldin também pode registrar ou atualizar lançamentos compatíveis. O Saldin nunca inicia transferências ou pagamentos, e você pode revogar o acesso quando quiser.
